name: NOBITAMUSIC
description: Telegram Group Calls streaming bot with some useful features, written in Python with Pyrogram and Py-Tgcalls. Supporting platforms like YouTube, Spotify, Resso, Apple Music, SoundCloud and M3U8 links.

BOT_TOKEN.description: A bot's token. Get it from @Botfather

EXTRA_PLUGINS.description: If you want to load extra plugins along with music plugins, fill True. If you don't want to load extra plugins, fill False.

MONGO_DB_URI.description: Get a MongoDB URL from https://cloud.mongodb.com. You can leave it blank if you want — the bot will use VIP's database for you.

OWNER_ID.description: The user id(s) of the user(s) you would like to add as OWNER. Multiple values should be separated with a space.

STRING_SESSION.description: A Pyrogram string session. One assistant is compulsory.

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Your log group ID. Add your bot and promote it as an admin with full rights. Use only a group, not a channel ID.

AUTO_GCAST.description: Fill here: On/Off — to turn auto gcast/broadcast messaging on or off.

AUTO_GCAST_MSG.description: Fill here the auto broadcast message which will be broadcast twice a day. Any type of message can be copied and pasted here.

UPSTREAM_REPO.description: If you don't know this, leave as it is
